reason: NSFlow maps neuro-symbolic workloads to a scalable FPGA dataflow architecture and evaluates end-to-end framework performance on neuro-symbolic AI tasks. Its hardware flow is not evaluated on transformer/LLM inference and does not provide an LLM-specific operator or serving result. FPGA is shared with linked works, but relation remains broad architectural adjacency.
title: NSFlow: An End-to-End FPGA Framework with Scalable Dataflow Architecture for Neuro-Symbolic AI
